findings.round38Grading: All 24 bullets in round38 failed because English claims were evaluated against Devanagari Hindi text only, causing entity matching and entailment checks to fail.
findings.modeA_vs_modeB: Under Mode A (Hindi only), English proper nouns and numbers without bilingual dictionary entries get flagged as unsupported. Under Mode B (English translation + Hindi source), all 5 real bullets successfully match and grade as SUPPORTED.
